title: Newsletter Purge Progress
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inbox:stats
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(newsletter_unread) as newsletter_unread, avg(unsubscribe_candidates) as unsubscribe_candidates by _time
| sort - _time
description: Shows whether inbox cleanup is actually reducing newsletter clutter over time.
value: A purge feels satisfying in one session, but the trend tells you whether the system is healthier or just briefly tidier.
implementation: Send inbox stats with newsletter counts to `index=personal`; review weekly clutter and unsubscribe-candidate trends.
visualization: Weekly chart of newsletter unread count and candidate count.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether your inbox clean-up is really cutting newsletter clutter or only making it look better for a day or two.
